logger.doc:name: Log Request
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- "[Account Details API] Received Add Account request: " ++ write(payload, "application/json")]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var newAccountId = payload.accountId default ("ACC-" ++ (randomInt(900000) + 100000) as String) --- { accountId: newAccountId, accountNumber: payload.accountNumber, customerId: payload.customerId, accountType: payload.accountType, balance: payload.balance default 0.00, currency: payload.currency default "USD", status: payload.status default "ACTIVE", branchCode: payload.branchCode default "BR-MAIN" }

db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO accounts (account_id, account_number, customer_id, account_type, balance, currency, status, branch_code, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:accountId, :accountNumber, :customerId, :accountType, :balance, :currency, :status, :branchCode, NOW(), NOW())

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var timestamp = now() --- { message: "Account created successfully in MySQL database", accountId: vars.accountData.accountId, account: { accountId: vars.accountData.accountId, accountNumber: vars.accountData.accountNumber, customerId: vars.accountData.customerId, accountType: vars.accountData.accountType, balance: vars.accountData.balance as Number, currency: vars.accountData.currency, status: vars.accountData.status, branchCode: vars.accountData.branchCode, createdAt: timestamp, updatedAt: timestamp } }

logger.doc:name: Log Response
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- "[Account Details API] Successfully inserted account: " ++ (vars.accountData.accountId default "")]

logger.doc:name: Log Request
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- "[Account Details API] Fetching accounts with query: " ++ write(attributes.queryParams, "application/json")]

db:select.doc:name: Query Accounts from MySQL
db:select.db:sql: SELECT account_id AS accountId, account_number AS accountNumber, customer_id AS customerId, account_type AS accountType, balance, currency, status, branch_code AS branchCode, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM accounts WHERE (:customerId IS NULL OR customer_id = :customerId) AND (:status IS NULL OR status = :status)

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- payload map (item) -> { accountId: item.accountId, accountNumber: item.accountNumber, customerId: item.customerId, accountType: item.accountType, balance: item.balance as Number, currency: item.currency, status: item.status, branchCode: item.branchCode, createdAt: item.createdAt, updatedAt: item.updatedAt }

logger.doc:name: Log Result Size
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- "[Account Details API] Retrieved " ++ (sizeOf(payload) as String) ++ " account(s) from MySQL"]

logger.doc:name: Log Request
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- "[Account Details API] Fetching account by ID: " ++ (attributes.uriParams.accountId default "")]

db:select.doc:name: Query Account by ID from MySQL
db:select.db:sql: SELECT account_id AS accountId, account_number AS accountNumber, customer_id AS customerId, account_type AS accountType, balance, currency, status, branch_code AS branchCode, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM accounts WHERE account_id = :accountId

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var item = payload[0] --- { accountId: item.accountId, accountNumber: item.accountNumber, customerId: item.customerId, accountType: item.accountType, balance: item.balance as Number, currency: item.currency, status: item.status, branchCode: item.branchCode, createdAt: item.createdAt, updatedAt: item.updatedAt }

logger.doc:name: Log Response
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- "[Account Details API] Successfully fetched account: " ++ (payload.accountId default "")]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { timestamp: now(), status: vars.httpStatus, error: "Not Found", message: "Account with ID " ++ (attributes.uriParams.accountId default "") ++ " not found", correlationId: correlationId }

logger.doc:name: Log Response
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- "[Account Details API] Account not found with ID: " ++ (payload.accountId default "")]

logger.doc:name: Log Request
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- "[Account Details API] Updating account ID: " ++ (vars.accountId default "")]

db:update.doc:name: Update Account in MySQL
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE accounts SET balance = COALESCE(:balance, balance), currency = COALESCE(:currency, currency), account_type = COALESCE(:accountType, account_type), status = COALESCE(:status, status), branch_code = COALESCE(:branchCode, branch_code), updated_at = NOW() WHERE account_id = :accountId
db:update.db:input-parameters: #[output application/java --- { accountId: vars.accountId, balance: vars.updatePayload.balance, currency: vars.updatePayload.currency, accountType: vars.updatePayload.accountType, status: vars.updatePayload.status, branchCode: vars.updatePayload.branchCode }]

db:select.doc:name: Fetch Updated Account
db:select.db:sql: SELECT account_id AS accountId, account_number AS accountNumber, customer_id AS customerId, account_type AS accountType, balance, currency, status, branch_code AS branchCode, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM accounts WHERE account_id = :accountId

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var item = payload[0] --- { message: "Account updated successfully in MySQL database", accountId: vars.accountId, account: { accountId: item.accountId, accountNumber: item.accountNumber, customerId: item.customerId, accountType: item.accountType, balance: item.balance as Number, currency: item.currency, status: item.status, branchCode: item.branchCode, createdAt: item.createdAt, updatedAt: item.updatedAt } }

logger.message: #[output text/plain --- "[Account Details API] Successfully updated account: " ++ (vars.accountId default "")]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { timestamp: now(), status: vars.httpStatus, error: "Not Found", message: "Cannot update: Account with ID " ++ (vars.accountId default "") ++ " not found", correlationId: correlationId }
